probe_script:
import json,sys,torch,triton
import tnca.torch_device as D
from tnca.triton_backend.driver import _Sessions
D.register()
assert not _Sessions.open, 'registration unexpectedly opened a device'
print(json.dumps(dict(python=sys.version,torch=torch.__version__,triton=triton.__version__,device=str(torch.device('tnca')),opened_sessions=len(_Sessions.open),status='software-registration-pass')),flush=True)
runner_script:

source /opt/xilinx/xrt/setup.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
cd /home/zzhouch/tnca_srcR40checkpoint_642c660 || exit 2

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' MAX_JOBS=1

rc=$?
printf '%s
' "$rc" > /home/zzhouch/tnca_build/r40_checkpoint642_prepare/prepare.exit
